title: Symmetry of the prescribed Fourier kernel
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\mathcal F$ be a nonempty finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $a,x$ be sign vectors of length $n$. The prescribed Fourier kernel evaluated at $(a,x)$ equals the kernel evaluated at $(x,a)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal F$ is a nonempty finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
$a$ and $x$ are sign vectors of length $n$
